Title patterns look at the title only; concept/industry/positive/negative patterns look at the description (and title). Levels: 100+ Excellent, 75+ Strong, 50+ Possible; below minScore (config.json) the job is hidden (logged to data/filtered.log). Edit patterns/weights here – no code changes needed.
